derivation: Accepted verification/seal.json candidateSources independently joined to verification/bindings.json preserved entries, producer finalSources and audit-02 sourcePaths, not derived from receipt or status.

methods.git: All invocations prefixed using env GIT_MASTER=1 GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; status/diff ignore submodules. cat-file blob invoked for every raw delta blob; compared SHA-256 and bytes against accepted candidate and current lstat mode.
methods.inventory: Retained precommit/recipe.txt reproduced in-process with node:fs/promises lstat/readdir/readlink/readFile and SHA-256, without following symlink directories. Both inventory record formats constructed with original key order, sorted by POSIX path and serialized as compact UTF-8 JSONL with a final newline. Each original row compared field by field to the newly walked same path; additions listed separately. Aggregate hashes never substitute for original per-entry baselines.
methods.permissionException: Only weighted-receipt directory size 192 -> 224 is expected metadata growth for excluded commit/ creation; kind, 0755 mode and null directory hash unchanged. New commit/ root and descendants are excluded evidence, never silently treated as missing baselines.
methods.seals: Every retained producer/verifier and admission path rehashed with original byte lengths and available original modes. Exact memberships compared independently, including each self-excluded seal. No missing historical mode is inferred from git-mode serialization.
methods.runtime: No tests, builds, CLI or auditor replay. Rehashed original check logs against checks.json, verified sealed commands/results/coverage and all retained runtime/auditor witness files. Identity equality transfers the accepted runtime proof to the actual commit; not a fresh execution claim.
